scenario_description:
Objective: Prepare the required participant cue packet for Thursday's assigned breakout-sequencing microteach.
Emerging Need: Role assignment is initially open; once Rowan is named lead, the live activity requires two accessible room-specific cue cards, which have not yet been prepared.
Decision Context: The stored learner-owned activity outline supplies distinct room prompts and formatting constraints. A generic agenda or an account-permission ticket cannot supply those participant materials.
Consequence: Drafting and submitting the two cue cards before packet production enables the planned live exercise; missing that production cycle leaves the assigned session without its required participant instructions.

parameter.subject: M7 facilitation studio roles still being balanced
parameter.body: Tomorrow's M7 studio is confirmed, but observer, co-facilitator and lead roles are still being balanced. Host accounts are already enabled for all learners. Only a final lead assignment requires an individual participant cue packet; observers and co-facilitators use the lead's materials, so no packet submission is needed before the role roster.

parameter.title: M7 virtual facilitation studio
parameter.description: Role roster pending; possible observer, co-facilitator, or lead-facilitator track for synchronous learning design practice.

parameter.name: Continuing Ed Studio Materials Desk
parameter.notes: Verified desk for accessible participant packets for instructional-design studios; no role provisioning service.

parameter.content: Final roster: Rowan is lead for session VC-M7-0528-A, breakout sequencing microteach. This cohort uses locally cached accessible cue packets, downloaded the evening before class, because live screen sharing and file distribution are unavailable inside the two breakout rooms. Each lead must supply the two room-specific cue cards from their approved activity by 15:30 today. Tomorrow's studio runs 10:00–11:30.

parameter.subject: Thursday participant packets completed
parameter.body: The 15:30 participant-packet intake has closed; Thursday's accessible packets have been exported and released for download without cue cards for VC-M7-0528-A. Late submissions enter Friday 12:00 production. The Thursday lead slot requires its two prepared room cues and has no live-file distribution route.
